evals.name: capture-with-fields-and-repeat
evals.prompt: Add a todo to send Priya the Q4 deck by Friday, high priority, tag it work. And remind me every Monday to check the build dashboard.
evals.expected_output: Two items: 'Send Priya the Q4 deck' due Fri 2026-11-06, priority 1 or 2, label work, title free of the date words; and a 'Check the build dashboard' item repeating @mon. Reply confirms both with short ids.

evals.name: due-today-and-complete
evals.prompt: what's due today? also i went to the dentist this morning so mark that one done
evals.expected_output: Lists today's/overdue items (pay rent overdue, dentist, standup notes) and marks only the dentist item done; other items untouched.

evals.name: triage-inbox-with-rules
evals.prompt: Triage my inbox: anything about the cluster goes to next with a #brgs label, the rest goes to someday.
evals.expected_output: The two cluster items are status next with label brgs (existing labels kept); the other inbox items are someday; the inbox is empty; non-inbox items untouched.
seed: Fix the flaky deploy on the dev cluster

evals.name: cli-fallback-capture
evals.prompt: add these to my todo list: call mom tomorrow, buy dog food (it's an errand), and I'm waiting on Dana to send the budget numbers
evals.expected_output: Without MCP tools, uses `todo add` with single-quoted capture text: 'Call mom' due tomorrow, 'Buy dog food' #errand, and a budget-numbers item waiting on Dana.

evals.name: add-label-keeps-existing
evals.prompt: tag the passport renewal as urgent too
evals.expected_output: Renew passport gets label urgent added; its existing labels #travel and #docs are kept; nothing else changes.

evals.name: ambiguous-title-asks
evals.expected_output: Two open items mention budget; the model does not guess: it closes neither and asks which one, showing both short ids.

evals.name: jira-local-priority
evals.prompt: PLAT-530 matters less to me this week, push it down my list. Oh and PLAT-611 got reassigned to Marcus, get it off my list.
evals.expected_output: PLAT-530 gets a local_priority override lower than its Jira priority; its Jira-owned priority is unchanged. PLAT-611 is removed from the list without being marked done or cancelled (deleted locally, Jira untouched).

evals.name: whats-on-my-plate
evals.expected_output: A grouped overview: overdue/today first (pay rent overdue, standup), then next items by priority, plus waiting items whose follow-up matters; deferred and someday items left out; no changes made.

evals.name: vague-date
evals.prompt: add a todo to review Ana's design doc by end of next week
evals.expected_output: One item 'Review Ana's design doc' due Fri 2026-11-13 (next week's Friday, not this week's eow 2026-11-06), with no date words left in the title.
